nodes.label: Microsoft
nodes.relation: Azure buys NVIDIA racks for itself, OpenAI and Anthropic, and is ramping its own Maia chips
nodes.summary: Microsoft is raising spend toward about $170 billion in fiscal 2027, but its CFO says the build can slow quickly and an accounting change already lowered the headline capex number without any real cut.
brief: Largest Azure GPU buyer
Its headline capex can drop on accounting alone, so the kill test needs its lease numbers too.
nodes.health: Uncommenced data center lease commitments reached $329.1 billion, up from $196.6 billion.

nodes.label: Amazon
nodes.relation: AWS buys NVIDIA systems while moving more of its own and its customers' work onto Trainium
nodes.summary: Amazon says 2027 spend goes up meaningfully and AWS can grow above 40% in 2027 and 2028, but a rising share of that build is Trainium.
brief: Biggest cloud, Trainium maker
Its 2027 budget rises, but more of each dollar goes to its own chips.
nodes.health: AWS grew 39% to a $184 billion run rate on about $220 billion of 2026 capex.

nodes.label: Alphabet
nodes.relation: Google Cloud runs NVIDIA racks while building and selling its own TPU systems
nodes.summary: Alphabet promised a significant 2027 capex increase, and most of the TPU system revenue it has already signed lands in that same year.
brief: Hyperscaler and TPU seller
Its 2027 raise helps, but more of it builds TPUs that compete with NVIDIA.
nodes.health: Guides 2026 capex of $195-205 billion, with a significant increase in 2027.

nodes.label: Meta
nodes.relation: Buys NVIDIA, AMD and Google TPU capacity while ramping its own MTIA chips
nodes.summary: Meta is the only one of the four with no 2027 capex direction in numbers; it says it will keep investing aggressively and will give the budget on its fourth-quarter call.
brief: Largest non-cloud GPU buyer
The one big four budget not yet set, and the likeliest to wobble.
nodes.health: Guides 2026 capex of $135-145 billion; says it will keep investing aggressively in 2027.

nodes.label: AWS Trainium
nodes.relation: Amazon's in-house AI accelerator, sold inside AWS and from late 2027 outside it
nodes.summary: Trainium revenue commitments grew more than 20 times in a year, and Amazon plans to sell the chip outside AWS late in 2027.
brief: Amazon's custom AI chip
Every Trainium rack AWS fills is a rack NVIDIA does not sell.
nodes.health: Revenue commitments up more than 20x year over year; chips business growing triple digits.

nodes.label: Google TPU
nodes.relation: Google's in-house accelerator, now sold as full systems to other companies
nodes.summary: TrendForce expects TPU shipments to at least double in 2027, and Alphabet expects most of its signed TPU system sales to be recognized that year.
brief: Google's custom AI chip
The most direct substitute for NVIDIA GPUs inside and outside Google.
nodes.health: Shipments seen up over 70% in 2026 and at least doubling in 2027.

nodes.label: Meta MTIA
nodes.relation: Meta's in-house AI chip, designed with Broadcom and made by TSMC
nodes.summary: Meta plans to deploy its newest in-house chip in the first half of 2027 and commit more than 1 gigawatt of it over 12 months.
brief: Meta's custom AI chip
Its 2027 ramp takes inference work Meta would otherwise put on NVIDIA.
nodes.health: First chips came back within 2-3% of simulated performance; over 1 GW committed.

nodes.label: TrendForce
nodes.relation: Industry tracker of AI server shipments and cloud capex
nodes.summary: TrendForce's November outlook sees AI servers growing about 30% in 2027 and custom chip shipments doubling to pass GPUs.
brief: AI server market tracker
Its 2027 unit forecasts show how much capex goes to custom chips.
nodes.health: Forecasts 2027 AI server growth of 30% to 36% across its reports.

nodes.label: Hyperscaler capex
nodes.relation: The budgets that pay for most NVIDIA data center revenue
nodes.summary: Hyperscale customers bought 56% of NVIDIA's data center revenue last quarter, and their capex through 2027 is set to grow faster than the cash flow that pays for it.
brief: Big four cloud capital spending
Hyperscalers bought $60.1B of NVIDIA's $107.6B data center revenue last quarter.
nodes.health: Capex is set to rise about $534 billion by 2027 against $340 billion more cash flow.

nodes.label: Marvell
nodes.relation: Co-designs custom AI chips for AWS and Microsoft
nodes.summary: Marvell's December 1 results are the first read this quarter on how fast the AWS and Microsoft custom chip programs are ramping.
brief: Custom chip design partner
Its custom revenue guide shows how fast AWS and Microsoft shift off GPUs.
nodes.health: Reports third quarter fiscal 2027 results and guidance on December 1, 2026.

signals.headline: NVIDIA raises its fiscal 2028 revenue growth outlook to about 75% from 70%
signals.whyItMatters: Fiscal 2028 is mostly calendar 2027, so NVIDIA is telling investors it already sees next year's buyer budgets rising, which is the opposite of the kill test.

signals.headline: NVIDIA's AI cloud, industrial and enterprise sales grew 195% to $47.5 billion, against 71% growth for hyperscalers
signals.whyItMatters: Hyperscale customers are now only about 56% of NVIDIA's data center revenue, so a cut by two of the big four would hurt less than the thesis assumes.
signals.evidence: their year-over-year growth rate of 195% exceeded the 71% growth in hyperscale

signals.headline: Microsoft CFO dismisses the AI overcapacity worry but says spending can be reined in if demand changes
signals.whyItMatters: Hood is telling investors the land and building spend is flexible, so Microsoft could slow orders within a quarter or two if Azure demand softens.
signals.evidence: If the demand environment changes, you just slow down

signals.headline: Microsoft lowers its capex outlook because of an accounting change, not a spending slowdown
signals.whyItMatters: Moving data center leases from finance to operating treatment cut the reported capex number by about $15 billion while lease commitments jumped, so a headline capex cut is not proof the kill test has fired.
signals.evidence: Uncommenced lease commitments rose to $329.1 billion from $196.6 billion

signals.headline: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says, but first it will spend big
signals.whyItMatters: If AWS really grows above 40% in both 2027 and 2028, Amazon needs more capacity each year, which keeps its share of rack orders rising even as Trainium grows.
signals.evidence: we believe that AWS can grow north of 40% in each 2027 and in 2028

signals.headline: Amazon says Trainium revenue commitments rose more than 20x and it will sell the chip outside AWS late in 2027
signals.whyItMatters: Amazon's 2027 capex can rise without NVIDIA getting a matching share, and from late 2027 Trainium competes for other companies' budgets too.
signals.evidence: intend to do so late in 2027

signals.headline: Google Cloud starts shipping TPU systems and becomes a chipmaker
signals.whyItMatters: Alphabet expects most of its signed TPU system sales to land in 2027, the same year NVIDIA is counting on rising hyperscaler budgets.
signals.evidence: the vast majority of the revenues from these agreements will be realized in 2027

signals.headline: TrendForce 2027 forecast: Google TPU shipments to at least double again, NVIDIA high-end platforms up 30%
signals.whyItMatters: If TPUs at least double while NVIDIA's high-end units grow about 30%, Google's spending growth goes disproportionately to its own chip.
signals.evidence: 預期 2027 年出貨量將持續翻倍以上 (2027 shipments expected to at least double again)

signals.headline: AI Server Outlook: 30% Growth Expected in 2027, but Supply Chain Prospects Diverge
signals.whyItMatters: TrendForce sees custom chip units doubling and passing GPUs in 2027, so rising cloud budgets no longer translate one for one into NVIDIA orders.
signals.evidence: ASIC shipments double and pass GPUs

signals.headline: Meta targets 1H27 deployment for new TSMC-made AI chip, claims efficiency edge over NVIDIA
signals.whyItMatters: Meta is committing over 1 gigawatt of its own chip in 2027 and says a 30% chip cost premium is hard to justify at that scale, which caps NVIDIA's share of its budget.

signals.headline: Analysis: AI investment boom puts Big Tech's free cash flow under pressure
signals.whyItMatters: If the five big spenders add $1.57 of capex for every $1 of new cash flow through 2027, any slip in AI revenue makes a budget cut more likely.

signals.headline: Marvell announces conference call to review third quarter of fiscal 2027 results
signals.whyItMatters: Marvell co-designs Trainium and Maia, so its December 1 custom revenue guide is the next dated read on how much 2027 hyperscaler spend skips NVIDIA.
signals.evidence: on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time
